# Johnson Pope

> > A full-service law firm in Tampa Bay with 50+ years of experience serving clients across estate planning, healthcare law, mergers & acquisitions, and Florida business law.

Johnson Pope (Johnson Pope Bokor Ruppel & Burns, LLP) is a Tampa-based law firm with offices throughout the Tampa Bay Area, including St. Petersburg and Clearwater. The firm specializes in estate planning, healthcare law, healthcare compliance, land use, and M&A transactions, with multiple attorneys recognized as Tampa Magazine Top Lawyers.
